Name: FreeRTOS-Plus-TCP echo client on MPS2 AN385
Why: A real embedded project nobody here wrote, whose build discards seven compiled translation units. It is the smallest case that distinguishes a tool reading the source tree from a tool reading the link.

Upstream.CommitNote: NOT RECORDED when the tree was built on 2026-10-12, and the 1.6GB clone is gone. This is why component versions are not-established for this case: with no commit there is no way back to the manifest files that would settle them. Re-cloning and rebuilding at a recorded commit is the first fix, and BUILD.md gives the recipe.

Toolchain.FlagNote: The demo's own Makefile already emits the map with --gc-sections, unchanged by us. That matters: the configuration this case depends on is the project's, not one we imposed to make the result come out.

Artifacts.ImageDigestNote: NOT RECORDED, and the artifact was not kept. Dimension 'bound to the binary' cannot be scored on this case until it is rebuilt.

Evidence.TotalsNote: CORRECTED 2026-10-13. These figures were re-established after a defect was found in BOTH map readers -- cres_t4.service.linker_map and the Go collector's internal/linkermap. Every sized line in the memory map was being counted, including the output sections an ELF file carries and a device does not run: .debug_*, .comment, .ARM.attributes, .riscv.attributes. Those are stripped before the image is flashed, so counting them inflated every figure by a factor that depends on nothing but the compiler's -g setting. The previous totals are kept in PreviousTotals so the size of the error stays on the record, and the bytes are now reported separately as MetadataBytes rather than dropped.

NotScoreable.versions: No recorded commit, so no component version is established.
NotScoreable.licences: Recorded from each project's published licensing but NOT checked against the LICENSE files in the built tree, so not independently verified.
